visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a black T-shirt is in an indoor setting with white paneled walls. He holds four Ultraman action figures in his hand, looking at the camera with a confused and slightly annoyed facial expression. He gestures with the toys towards the camera while shifting his posture slightly. (2) The scene cuts to the same man holding a single grey and red Ultraman figure (Zero) close to the lens. He then swaps it for other figures in succession, including a blue-accented one and a silver one, pointing at their specific features with his other hand. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The man continues showing different monster-shaped toys, such as one with a large orange belly and another with a red frill. A young boy in a blue shirt is now visible sitting on a grey sofa in the background. A woman with a black cap and denim jacket appears from the side, smiling and leaning towards the man as he holds up a final white dragon-like toy. Bright text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame consistently.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: POV:當爸爸前. 我實在搞不懂. (2) [Subtitle]: 百貨公司賣. 賣這麼多長的一樣. 鹹蛋超人幹什麼? (3) [Subtitle]: 不就長一樣嗎? (4) [Subtitle]: POV:當爸爸三年後. 跟你們介紹. 這個是賽羅. (5) [Subtitle]: 這是布雷薩. 這是納克斯. 這是雅克. 這是歐布. (6) [Subtitle]: 他們每一支都很有. 請不要搞錯好嗎? (7) [Subtitle]: 這是貝蒙斯坦. 這是眼Q. 這是捲領鐵列斯頓. 這是哥莫拉. (8) [Subtitle]: 妳躲在我後面幹嘛? 這些都是超人力霸王! (9) [Subtitle]: 對! 這一一個! 彩虹輝龍. (10) [Subtitle]: 各位不要搞錯. 他們每一個都有名字.
